question: The Government of India Constituted Narcotics Control Bureau in ________.
solution:
Correct answer is __**1986.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In presence of this provision, the Government of India constituted the **NARCOTICS CONTROL BUREAU** on the **17th of March, 1986**.
 
• The Narcotics Control Bureau was created in **March 1986** in words of Section 4 (3) of **the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985.**
 
• The Narcotics Control Bureau (abbr. NCB) is an Indian central law enforcement and intelligence agency under the **Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.**
 
• The Narcotics Control Bureau is an agency incharge for **fighting drug trafficking and the abuse of illicit substances**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45d7c29728c595b75896d2dd48da32f14e7de02930ff3a74c6626af478921ffa.png]

• ​**National Crime Investigation Bureau** is a name of **Crime and Corruption killer team**, operating over India with help of good officers and powerful legal team. 
 
• **The Department of Revenue** is mostly responsible for the following functions: -** All matters relating to levy and collection of Direct Taxes.**
 
• **The Department of Economic Affairs **(DEA), Ministry of Finance, assists the Central Government.
